title: Best Buy celebrates Pokémon’s 30th anniversary with trading cards, Trade and Play event
summary: Best Buy is bringing the Poke-Fun to celebrate.
body_markdown:
By[Best Buy](https://corporate.bestbuy.com/)


August 25, 2026


Get ready, trainers! To celebrate the 30th anniversary of Pokémon Best Buy is bringing the excitement. On Aug. 29, 225 Best Buy stores across the country will have an in-store Trade & Play event, availability of exciting Pokémon card packs, and Bandai Pikachu Model Kits.


## **In-store experience**


Looking for an electric weekend? Join us in-store at select locations on Aug. 29 from noon to 2 p.m. local time for our Trade & Play event. Activities will include:


- **Trading card fun:** Level up your card collection by trading cards with other fans. Plus, if you’re just getting into Pokémon cards, we’ll have event leaders who can share tips on how to play.


- **Epic giveaways:** To celebrate 30 years, we’re giving away 3-card fun packs, Bandai Pikachu Model Kits and branded folders (while supplies last).


Additionally, beginning Aug. 31, Best Buy stores across the country will have in-store Pokémon display takeovers.


## **Card drops to shop**


Starting Sept. 16, Best Buy stores will carry the latest products from Pokémon as they are released. Here’s a look at what fans can expect:


- [Pokémon 30th Celebration Poster Collection](https://www.bestbuy.com/product/pokemon-trading-card-game-30th-celebration-poster-collection/JJG2TL8X7G/sku/6685565)


- [Pokémon 30th Celebration Elite Trainer Box](https://www.bestbuy.com/product/pokemon-trading-card-game-30th-celebration-elite-trainer-box/JJG2TL8XCJ/sku/6685559)


- [Pokémon 30th Celebration Tech Sticker Collection](https://www.bestbuy.com/product/pokemon-trading-card-game-30th-celebration-tech-sticker-collection-1-tech-sticker-collection-per-order-styles-may-vary/JJG2TL8X74/sku/6685574)


Check out our Pokémon page[here](https://www.bestbuy.com/site/brands/pokemon/pcmcat1625858585375.c?id=pcmcat1625858585375) to find a Trade & Play event at a store near you.


*Visit*[BestBuy.com](https://www.bestbuy.com/) *to shop for all things Pokémon*
